current_date: Last updated June 2020 (Appendix 1 list of documents: last updated September 2019)
current_evidence: The council's Submit a planning application page (last updated 12 June 2026) still links the joint 'Local Validation List for Adur & Worthing Councils' (Media,99591) for Adur, says Worthing has its own new list from 1 April 2026 (not covering Adur), and says 'A new validation document for Adur will be finalised later this year'; a Draft Adur Validation Requirements was only approved for consultation on 25 June 2026 (decision A/REG/003/26-27), with no adoption found (search/fetch budget ran out before final adoption could be confirmed).

issues.detail: Almost every requirement is placed under 'Full planning' with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named... placed under Full planning', and Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Advertisement and the other types are given '(none)'. The source list is general and applies across application types: e.g. the Air Quality statement is required with every application, Tree Survey wherever trees on/adjacent to the site could be affected, Heritage Statement wherever heritage assets are affected, Biodiversity survey wherever protected species may be affected, and Appendix 1 specifically requires a Householder Flood Risk Assessment form for householder sites in an EA flood zone. Examples of INFERRED placements: Arboricultural/Tree Survey, Archaeology, Ecology, Lighting, Parking, Transport, Telecoms.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 (Media,136954): 'Householder... A Householder Flood Risk Assessment form if the site is wholly or partly in an Environment Agency flood zone'; main list item 2 Air Quality: statement 'needed with every application'.

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment / statement not captured. Trigger: all developments must include a statement that the Sussex Air Quality and Emissions Mitigation Guidance has been followed; full AQA where relevant.
issues.evidence: List item 'Air Quality Assessment (AQA)': applies to all developments; statement showing the Sussex air quality guidance was followed needed with every application.

issues.detail: Affordable Housing Statement not captured. Trigger: sites of 10 or more dwellings (gross); Adur applies the 10-dwelling threshold from 8 April 2020.
issues.evidence: List item 'Affordable Housing Statement': sites of 10+ dwellings (gross); 'Adur uses the 10-dwelling threshold from 8 April 2020'.

issues.detail: Foul Sewerage Assessment not captured. Trigger: major developments of 10+ dwellings (excluding conversions), sites of 0.5ha+ or 1,000 sqm+ floorspace, or any proposal involving a change to the sewerage system.
issues.evidence: List item 'Foul Sewerage Assessment (FSA)'.

issues.detail: Land Contamination Assessment not captured. Trigger: development on land that is or may be contaminated.
issues.evidence: List item 'Land Contamination Assessment'.

issues.detail: Noise Impact Assessment not captured. Trigger: development likely to generate noise that could disturb occupiers nearby, or noise-sensitive development near existing sources (railways, major roads, industry).
issues.evidence: List item 'Noise Impact Assessment'.

issues.detail: Refuse and Recycling Provision not captured. Trigger: all relevant applications must show bin storage and likely collection method on a plan.
issues.evidence: List item 'Refuse and Recycling Provision'.

issues.detail: Shoreham Harbour Sustainability Statement not captured as its own requirement. Trigger: applications within the Shoreham Harbour regeneration area (Adur-specific). Grokbot's Energy/Sustainability trigger 'to submit a Sustainability Statement.' appears to be a fragment of this item, conflated with the energy requirement.
issues.evidence: List item 'Shoreham Harbour': applications within the Shoreham Harbour area require a Sustainability Statement.

issues.detail: Town Centre Uses (Sequential Test and Retail/Impact Assessment) not captured. Trigger: main town centre uses outside a centre and not in accordance with an up-to-date Local Plan; in Adur an impact assessment is required for retail outside the Primary Shopping Area of 1,000 sqm net or more.
issues.evidence: List item 'Town Centre Uses (Sequential Test and Impact Assessment)'.

issues.detail: Stage 1 Road Safety Audit not captured. Trigger: major applications (10+ residential units or 1,000 sqm+ commercial) that alter the highway, intensify use of an access or propose off-site highway works.
issues.evidence: List item 'Transport Issues': 'A Stage 1 Road Safety Audit is required for major applications...'.

issues.detail: Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing Assessment is listed as a Full planning requirement, but the source expressly says it is NOT a validation requirement (may be requested during determination).
issues.evidence: Grokbot's own excerpt: 'Whilst not considered an appropriate requirement at validation stage...'.

issues.detail: Most tab_items are process text, fees, boilerplate or fragments, not requirements: the GBP 75 (+VAT) administration charge for postal/email submissions; 'Applications for work to trees will not currently incur an administration charge'; pre-application engagement text; 'completed checklist... will expedite the review process'; ANA boundaries 'provided to the West Sussex Districts and Boroughs'; and two broken URL fragments ('ment_data/file/289894/LIT_2745_c8ed3d.pdf Please also refer to Section 22...' and 'ments%20-%20Guidance%20on%20Methodology...').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists' sections.

issues.detail: Energy / Sustainability Statement trigger is a cut-off fragment ('to submit a Sustainability Statement.'). Source: required for all new major development in Adur, which must show renewables provide at least 10% of predicted energy demand.
issues.evidence: List item 'Energy/Sustainability Statement': all new major development in Adur (renewables for at least 10% of predicted energy).

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment trigger is generic web text ('may be required depending on the location...'). Source thresholds: major development of 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1 and all new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3 (householder form for householder sites in flood zones).
issues.evidence: List item 'Flood Risk Assessment (FRA)'; Appendix 1 Householder FRA form.

issues.detail: Drainage Strategy / SuDS trigger ('Any proposed surface water scheme must consider sustainable drainage principles') omits the actual thresholds: more than two dwellings or 1,000 sqm+ commercial floorspace, sites at fluvial or pluvial flood risk, and increases in impermeable area where there is no public surface water sewer.
issues.evidence: List item 'Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS)'.

issues.detail: Archaeology and Ecology triggers are mid-sentence fragments with no trigger ('an appropriate desk-based assessment and, where necessary, a field evaluation'.' and 'on any protected species of flora or fauna...'). Source: Historic Environment Record search/assessment where there is any indication of archaeology (ANAs, guidance thresholds); biodiversity survey where works may affect protected species, e.g. vegetation removal, watercourse changes, demolition of older buildings, roof works.
issues.evidence: List items 'Historic Environment Record (HER)' and 'Biodiversity Survey and Report'.

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning carries an unrelated tree text excerpt ('...BS58 37: 2012 Trees but will need to be purchased. 28.'), so both the requirement and the trigger are mismatched.
issues.evidence: Source item 27 'Tree Survey' contains the BS5837 text; schedule of works belongs to listed building/heritage.

issues.detail: Transport Assessment / Travel Plan triggers are cut off with a URL fragment ('...Methodology, and must comply fully with this guidance: ments%20-%20Guidance%20on%20Method'); Economic Statement and Marketing triggers are truncated and mix in Worthing-only SPD text that does not apply to Adur; Parking trigger only captures the on-street survey clause and omits that all full applications must show parking on a 1:200 block plan.
issues.evidence: List items 'Transport Issues', 'Economic Statement', 'Parking Provision'.

issues.detail: Ventilation / Extraction details is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source applies it to planning applications for A3/A4/A5/D2 uses including change of use and any application installing ventilation/extraction/air-conditioning equipment, not to prior approval. Structural Survey is placed only under Listed building consent, but the source also applies it to demolition of buildings that positively contribute to a Conservation Area and to loss-of-employment cases justified as unviable.
issues.evidence: List items 'Ventilation and Air Conditioning Statement' and 'Structural Surveys'.

issues.detail: Transport Assessment and Travel Plan rows use the identical excerpt; Employment/Economic Statement and Marketing/vacancy evidence rows also repeat the same Economic Statement text.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning.

issues.detail: Grokbot's note does not record that a Draft Adur Validation Requirements was approved for public consultation (decision A/REG/003/26-27, 25 June 2026, effective 3 July 2026). The 2020 joint list is still the operative Adur list but is expected to be replaced; the row should be flagged for re-check.
issues.evidence: Decision A/REG/003/26-27: 'To agree to the publication of the Draft Adur Validation Requirements for consultation' (draft PDF: democracy.adur-worthing.gov.uk/documents/s17172/AREG00326-27%20Adur%20Validation%20Requirements.pdf).

summary: Grokbot's link is still Adur's operative list (joint Adur & Worthing list, last updated June 2020), and the date is correct. A draft Adur-only list went to consultation in July 2026. The extraction is poor: about 9 local requirements are missing (Air Quality, Affordable Housing, Foul Sewerage, Contamination, Noise, Refuse, Shoreham Harbour, Town Centre Uses, Road Safety Audit), Daylight/Sunlight is wrongly listed as a requirement, most triggers are fragments, and nearly everything is guessed into Full planning.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
